changes.description: The changed files, BY ADDRESS (contract-records-by-address-v1). A seat supplies {path, base}: the file and the commit its change is measured from. The ENGINE stamps, at seal, from RunDeps.tree_root: blob_sha (git hash-object of the file, or the literal "deleted"), patch_sha256 (sha256 of `git diff <base> -- <path>`) and bytes (that diff's length). A consumer reads the change with `git diff <base> -- <path>` and checks it against patch_sha256. No patch body is ever model output.
